patches.name: pps_redirect
patches.purpose: Redirect hardcoded PPS path to /pps/volte_probe/ims for custom carrier config

patches.name: vops_bypass
patches.purpose: selectDomainVoice: bypass VoPS=0 network veto (cbnz r7 -> b 0x62c88)

patches.name: force_hdvoice_wfc
patches.purpose: updateImsServices: bypass restriction on VoLTE HD voice service (bne 0x9e820 -> nop)

patches.name: force_codec_amrwb
patches.purpose: initCodecs: force Codec.AMRWB = 1 in config dictionary (mov r1, r0 -> movs r1, #1)

patches.name: precondition_policy
patches.purpose: SIP client: force Precondition.Policy = volte (cbz r0 -> nop)

patches.name: carrier_whitelist_bypass
patches.purpose: ImsPpsCarrierCfgIr92Object: force UsePreconditions = 1 for all carriers (beq -> b)

patches.name: fast_update_trigger
patches.purpose: precondStep: bypass 8000ms QCI=1 bearer timer to immediately send UPDATE on 183 Session Progress (beq -> nop)

patches.name: default_codec_amrwb
patches.purpose: buildSdpOffer: default Codec.AMRWB to enabled=1 (movs r1, #0 -> movs r1, #1)

patches.name: never_skip_amrwb_cfg
patches.purpose: buildSdpOffer: never skip AMR-WB on config check (cbz r0 -> nop)

patches.name: never_skip_amrwb_media
patches.purpose: buildSdpOffer: never skip AMR-WB on media format check (cbz r0 -> nop)
